mentions.heading: Lithium-ion cell storage and recycling safety at facilities
mentions.detail: High volumes of lithium-ion cells, modules and packs stored and recycled at facilities; fire could disrupt operations
mentions.quote: While we have implemented safety procedures related to the handling of the cells, there can be no assurance that a safety issue or fire related to the cells would not disrupt our operations.

mentions.heading: We face risks associated with maintaining and expanding our international operations
mentions.detail: Manufacturing in China and Europe; local regulatory, permitting, staffing and domestic-preference risks
mentions.quote: Our operations in such jurisdictions, particularly as a company based in the U.S., with additional manufacturing operations in China and Europe, create risks relating to conforming our products to regulatory and safety requirements and charging and other electric infrastructures; organizing local operating entities; establishing, staffing and managing foreign business locations;

mentions.heading: International operations: global tax legislation changes
mentions.detail: Monitoring OECD base erosion and profit shifting plan
mentions.quote: For example, we monitor tax legislation changes on a global basis, including changes arising as a result of the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development’s multi-jurisdictional plan of action to address base erosion and profit shifting.

drivers.name: Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development’s multi-jurisdictional plan of action to address base erosion and profit shifting

mentions.heading: International operations: U.S. tariffs and retaliatory tariffs
mentions.detail: U.S. tariff increases and retaliatory tariffs already affected pricing; some EV and battery parts cannot be sourced domestically; China trade agreement uncertainty
mentions.quote: Retaliatory tariffs imposed by other countries on U.S. exports, further increases in U.S. tariffs, and the uncertainties surrounding domestic and foreign tariffs have impacted the pricing for our products, which could adversely impact demand.

mentions.heading: Our business may suffer if our products or features contain defects
mentions.detail: Software/hardware defects, delayed or restricted driver assistance features could cause recalls, liability and warranty costs
mentions.quote: If our products contain design or manufacturing defects, whether relating to our software or hardware, that cause them not to perform as designed or intended or that require repair, or certain features of our vehicles such as new driver
